headline: Iran hitting tankers beyond Hormuz
dek: Kpler recorded at least 18 vessel attacks in the past two weeks; LSEG analysts say Iran is hitting tankers well beyond Hormuz into the Gulf of Oman, jeopardizing Gulf crude loadings and ship-to-ship transfers; Brent back at $110.40 (+1.5%); Gulf indexes subdued on stalled Iran-US diplomacy.
fault_line: Pocketbook: $110 oil — who pays for Hormuz, consumers or Iran's enemies?
